title: CardPurchaseSet
description: A dated set of card-purchase rows awaiting statement-line prices, one row per ordered item. Field names follow the schema.org Order/OrderItem vocabulary (Order.orderDate, Order.paymentMethod, OrderItem.orderedItem, PriceSpecification price/priceCurrency) so the record reads directly against that vocabulary.

recordedAt.description: The date or date-time the set was recorded.

sourceId.description: The card statement or observation source id shared by every row that does not carry its own sourceId.

sourceStatus.description: The evidential status of the source, e.g. statement-lines-pending before the card statement posts exact amounts.

purchaseId.description: This row's own identifier, unique within the set.

orderDate.description: The order date, per schema.org Order.orderDate, as YYYY-MM-DD.

orderedItem.description: The item ordered, per schema.org OrderItem.orderedItem.

name.description: The item's name, per schema.org Product.name / Thing.name.

description.description: The item's description, per schema.org Thing.description.

quantity.description: The ordered quantity, per schema.org OrderItem.orderQuantity.

price.description: The line's price, per schema.org PriceSpecification (price/priceCurrency); null when the statement line has not yet posted an exact amount.

value.description: The exact price as a plain decimal string, per schema.org PriceSpecification.price; never a floating-point number.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code, per schema.org PriceSpecification.priceCurrency.

paymentMethod.description: The payment method, per schema.org Order.paymentMethod.

party.description: The name of the party whose payment instrument was charged.

instrument.description: The kind of payment instrument, aligned with schema.org's PaymentMethod enumeration members (CreditCard, cash, ...).

label.description: A human-readable label for the instrument. Never the card number.

owner.description: The name of the party whose book the ordered item is an asset of.

treatment.description: Whether the owner's book capitalizes the item as a fixed asset or expenses it.

expenseAccount.description: The Beancount expense account for an expense-treatment row; defaults to Expenses:Equipment when absent.

assetId.description: The fixed-asset register id for the item, when one is assigned.

assetCategory.description: The fixed-asset register category the item belongs to, when one is assigned.

usedFor.description: What the item is used for, supporting the ownership and treatment classification.

seller.description: The seller of the item, per schema.org Order.seller, when known.

sourceId.description: This row's own source id, overriding the set's sourceId, when the row was independently witnessed.
